keyLimits.en: 5 account-level custom fields, 1 sales pipeline, 7-day recycle bin retention.
15 account-level custom fields, 3 sales pipelines, 180-day recycle bin retention, adds HRIS/invoicing integrations and rate cards.
20+ custom fields, 5 pipelines, revenue forecasting, multiple subsidiaries, advanced security (SSO, 2FA enforcement, SCIM).

cautions.en: Note: the seed's own snapshot listed pricing as unpublished/on-quote, but the live pricing page shows public per-seat rates for Essential and Professional; only Ultimate is quote-based.

The pricing page's annual-vs-monthly figures for Essential/Professional could not be resolved cleanly (annual appeared to price higher per month than monthly billing), so only the monthly rate is recorded; verify the annual rate locally before publishing.

capabilities.en: All-in-one agency management: project management, resource planning, budgeting, and invoicing in one platform.
Time tracking with an AI assistant and AI-assisted time entries.
Reporting and forecasting, with a Scenario Builder on higher tiers.
API access and native Slack integration on all plans.

limitations.en: Advanced security controls (SSO, 2FA enforcement, SCIM) are Ultimate-only and require a custom quote.
HubSpot integration and webhooks are limited to the top Ultimate tier.

reason.en: Project management competitor used by agencies for delivery tracking.
All-in-one work management tool covering similar project and time-tracking ground.
Work OS competitor with project, resource, and budget tracking.

unknowns: Minimum seat count for Essential/Professional not stated as a hard requirement on the pricing page beyond the 10-user example used in the calculator.
conflicts: The queue seed snapshot flagged pricing as unpublished (comparePlan: 'Prix non public'), but the current official pricing page publishes per-seat rates for two of the three plans.
